API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPrivateCreate Prov Url
Create Prov Url
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/provUrl

Creates a provisioning template.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

ID of Cloud & Branch Connector provisioning template.

name
string

Name of Cloud & Branch Connector provisioning template.

desc
string

Description of Cloud & Branch Connector provisioning template.

provUrl
string

URL of Cloud & Branch Connector provisioning template.

provUrlType
string

URL type of Cloud & Branch Connector provisioning template.

Possible values: [ONPREM, CLOUD, DISABLED, MON_DELETED, DELETING, DELETING_LAST, DELETED]

provUrlData
object
usedInEcGroups
object[]
status
string

Deployment status of Cloud & Branch Connector provisioning template.

Possible values: [DEPLOYED, NOT_DEPLOYED]

lastModUid
object
lastModTime
int32

Last time Cloud & Branch Connector provisioning template was modified.

Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
